script.name: Script
script.description: Runs a program you choose on this PC and shows what it prints, such as a disk check or a backup status. It runs only after you approve it.
script.privacy: This widget runs a program on your PC every so often. It runs only what you approve in its settings, only on this PC, and never in safe mode. A run that takes longer than 10 seconds is stopped.
script.programHint: Atap runs the program with the options you list and shows what it prints. Nothing runs until you approve it.
script.unitHint: Shown after numbers, such as % or GB.
script.pathHint: For JSON output, where the value is, such as $.cpu. Leave it as $ to use all of the output.
script.editor.programHint: The full path to an .exe file, such as C:\Tools\check.exe. For a PowerShell script, use powershell.exe and add -File and the script path as options.
script.editor.argumentsHint: One per line. Each line goes to the program exactly as you type it.
script.editor.folderHint: Optional. Leave it empty to start in the program's own folder.
script.editor.review: This is exactly what will run
script.editor.approved: Approved on this PC. It runs each time the widget checks.
script.editor.changed: You made changes. The approved version keeps running until you approve the new one.
script.editor.notApproved: Not approved yet. It does not run until you approve it.
script.editor.unsaved: Changes are saved only when you approve them.
script.editor.noLock: Atap cannot keep approvals safe on this PC, so scripts cannot run here.
script.editor.cloudWarning: This uses a file in OneDrive. Anyone who can change that file through OneDrive decides what runs on this PC.
script.editor.problem.HiddenCharacter: There is a hidden or blank character in it. Type it again by hand.
script.editor.problem.ExecutableNotLocal: Use the full path to the program, starting with a drive letter such as C:.
script.editor.problem.ExecutableNotExe: The program must be an .exe file. To run a script, choose its program, such as powershell.exe, and add the script as an option.
script.editor.problem.WorkingFolderNotLo: Use the full path to the folder, starting with a drive letter such as C:.
script.editor.problem.ArgumentTooLong: An option is too long. Keep each one under 2048 characters.
script.editor.problem.InvalidArgument: An option has a character that cannot be used.
script.editor.problem.CommandTooLong: All together it is too long for Windows. Use fewer or shorter options.
script.safeMode: Scripts do not run in safe mode.
script.notSetUp: Choose what to run in this widget's settings.
script.needsApproval: Approve what this widget runs in its settings.
script.badTemplate: Check the value to show in this widget's settings.
script.failed: The program ended with an error and printed nothing.
script.tooMuch: It printed too much, so Atap stopped it.
script.timedOut: It took longer than 10 seconds, so Atap stopped it.
script.networkDrive: Programs on network drives or USB drives do not run. Use a program on this PC's own drive.
script.couldNotStart: The program could not start. Check that it is still there.
